reader.requirement: At --std 85 the implementation shall choose, and apply consistently, whether format 3 (RECORD CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5) produces fixed or variable length records; this compiler's documented choice (DOC-A.1-148) is variable length: each record written at its own description's size, never padded to integer-5, in every organization.

edition-consulted.switches: VaryingRecordInfo.BoundsEnforced = VARYING || DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (active from 2002): at 85 format 3's integers do not bound a WRITE; the variable-length choice itself (Varying non-null for any TO form) is edition-free

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the variable-length choice is the same at every edition, but from 2002 a record outside integer-4..integer-5 is refused with '44' (2023 GR19), while at 85 the record descriptions alone set the sizes.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c23_record_format3_variable covers a record sequential file with records inside 5..10; relative and indexed organizations, an OCCURS DEPENDING ON record and descriptions outside the integers are exercised only by the probes.

probes.printed: RECORD CONTAINS 5 TO 10 with 3-, 20- and ODO (2 + 2*n) records: WA..WD 00; read back L=03 [ABC], L=20, L=06 [12ZZYY], L=04 [12ZZ]; file bytes carry a 4-byte length head per record (03, 24, 06, 04)
probes.expected: variable length per the documented choice; each record at its own size

probes.printed: RELATIVE: RG 00 L=05 [ABCDE], RG 00 L=10 [FGHIJKLMNO], RG 10; INDEXED: XG 00 L=05 [K1xyz], XG 00 L=10 [K2abcdefgh], XG 10; READ after failed OPEN (35): USE MISS 47, MREAD 47
probes.expected: variable length in every organization; a READ of an unopened file is unsuccessful
2023 GR19 binds the range; 1985 does not (edition arm)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR13  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR13 [quote: It is implementor defined whether format 3 of the RECORD clause produces fixed length records or variable length records]

reader.notes: Any TO form binds FileModel.Varying, so format 3 is variable length at every edition, as DOC-A.1-148 documents; measured in sequential, relative and indexed files. The only edition switch is whether the integers bound a WRITE, which is GR14's business at 85.
reader.at-2023: same variable framing; out-of-range records refused with 44 per 2023 GR19

refuter.evidence: The implementor choice (variable length for format 3) is made and documented in docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-148.md and applied: rr1.cob at --std 85 writes a format 3 record with a 4-byte length head (04 00 00 00 '12AB'), unlike the same record under RECORD CONTAINS 10 or no RECORD clause (10 bytes, padded). GR13 only asks the choice be made; the size of an ODO record inside a variable format 3 file is GR14/GR15's business (see the GR14 case). cite.py: OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR13.
